# 1. Monthly panel

Treatment dataset (monthly):

```{r}
# TREATMENT PANEL — MONTHLY balanced panel of (muni, date) with treatment

all_dates <- seq.Date(as.Date("2019-02-01"), as.Date("2026-05-07"), by = "month")

muni_all <- tribble(
  ~Municipality,                    ~MunicipalityCode,

  "Freiburg im Breisgau, Stadt",    "08311000",
  "Oldenburg (Oldenburg), Stadt",   "03403000",
  "Dusseldorf, Stadt",              "05111000",
  "Stuttgart",                      "08111000",
  "Bielefeld, Stadt",               "05711000",
  "Darmstadt, Wissenschaftsstadt",  "06411000",
  "Bonn, Stadt",                    "05314000",
  "Göttingen, Stadt",               "03159016",
  "Potsdam, Landeshauptstadt",      "12054000",
  "Fröndenberg/Ruhr, Stadt",        "05978012",
  "Weilheim i.OB, St",              "09190157",
  "Koln",                           "05315000",
  "Braunschweig",                   "03101000",
  "Kiel, Landeshauptstadt",         "01002000",
  "Heidelberg, Stadt",              "08221000",
  "Munchen",                        "09162000",
  "Jena, Stadt",                    "16053000",
  "Jever, Stadt",                   "03455007",
  "Ulm, Universitätsstadt",         "08421000",
  "Ingolstadt, Stadt",              "09161000",
  "Berlin",                         "11000000",
  "Essen",                          "05113000",
  "Regensburg, Stadt",              "09362000",
  "Dresden",                        "14612000",
  "Duisburg",                       "05112000",
  "Augsburg, Stadt",                "09761000",
  "Dortmund",                       "05913000",
  "Frankfurt am Main, Stadt",       "06412000",
  "Kassel, Stadt",                  "06611000",

  "Lüneburg, Hansestadt",           "03355022",
  "Friedrichshafen, Stadt",         "08435016",
  "Kornwestheim, Stadt",            "08118046",
  "Erlangen",                       "09562000",
  "Wickede (Ruhr)",                 "05974056",
  "Bremen",                         "04011000",
  "Bremerhaven",                    "04012000",
  "Reutlingen",                     "08415061",
  "Erfurt",                         "16051000",
  "Hannover",                       "03241001",
  "Munster",                        "05515000",
  "Magdeburg, Landeshauptstadt",    "15003000",
  "Halle (Saale), Stadt",           "15002000",
  "Leipzig, Stadt",                 "14713000",
  "Karlsruhe, Stadt",               "08212000",
  "Wiesbaden, Landeshauptstadt",    "06414000",
  "Aachen, Stadt",                  "05334002",
  "Saarbrücken, Landeshauptstadt",  "10041100",
  "Fürth, Stadt",                   "09563000",
  "Chemnitz, Stadt",                "14511000",
  "Hamburg",                        "02000000"
)

data.treatment <- crossing(
  MunicipalityCode = muni_all$MunicipalityCode,
  date = all_dates
) |>
  left_join(muni_all, by = "MunicipalityCode") |>
  mutate(
    treatment = case_when(
      MunicipalityCode == "08311000" & date >= as.Date("2019-09-01") ~ 1L,  # Freiburg im Breisgau
      MunicipalityCode == "03403000" & date >= as.Date("2020-01-01") & date <= as.Date("2023-03-01") ~ 1L,  # Oldenburg
      MunicipalityCode == "05111000" & date >= as.Date("2020-05-01") & date <= as.Date("2026-01-01") ~ 1L,  # Dusseldorf
      MunicipalityCode == "08111000" & date >= as.Date("2020-11-01") & date <= as.Date("2025-12-01") ~ 1L,  # Stuttgart
      MunicipalityCode == "05711000" & date >= as.Date("2020-11-01") & date <= as.Date("2023-12-01") ~ 1L,  # Bielefeld
      MunicipalityCode == "06411000" & date >= as.Date("2021-07-01") ~ 1L,  # Darmstadt
      MunicipalityCode == "05314000" & date >= as.Date("2021-09-01") ~ 1L,  # Bonn
      MunicipalityCode == "03159016" & (  # Göttingen
        (date >= as.Date("2021-11-01") & date <= as.Date("2025-12-01")) |
        (date >= as.Date("2026-06-01"))
      ) ~ 1L,
      MunicipalityCode == "12054000" & (  # Potsdam
        (date >= as.Date("2022-03-01") & date <= as.Date("2022-12-01")) |
        (date >= as.Date("2023-07-01") & date <= as.Date("2023-12-01")) |
        (date >= as.Date("2024-03-01") & date <= as.Date("2024-08-01")) |
        (date >= as.Date("2025-06-01"))
      ) ~ 1L,
      MunicipalityCode == "05978012" & date >= as.Date("2022-03-01") & date <= as.Date("2023-12-01") ~ 1L,  # Fröndenberg
      MunicipalityCode == "09190157" & date >= as.Date("2022-04-01") & date <= as.Date("2024-12-01") ~ 1L,  # Weilheim
      MunicipalityCode == "05315000" & date >= as.Date("2022-04-01") ~ 1L,  # Koln
      MunicipalityCode == "03101000" & date >= as.Date("2022-04-01") ~ 1L,  # Braunschweig
      MunicipalityCode == "01002000" & date >= as.Date("2022-04-01") & date <= as.Date("2025-12-01") ~ 1L,  # Kiel
      MunicipalityCode == "08221000" & date >= as.Date("2022-09-01") & date <= as.Date("2024-03-01") ~ 1L,  # Heidelberg
      MunicipalityCode == "09162000" & date >= as.Date("2022-10-01") ~ 1L,  # Munchen
      MunicipalityCode == "16053000" & date >= as.Date("2022-11-01") & date <= as.Date("2023-12-01") ~ 1L,  # Jena
      MunicipalityCode == "03455007" & date >= as.Date("2023-01-01") & date <= as.Date("2023-12-01") ~ 1L,  # Jever
      MunicipalityCode == "08421000" & date >= as.Date("2023-01-01") & date <= as.Date("2026-08-01") ~ 1L,  # Ulm
      MunicipalityCode == "09161000" & date >= as.Date("2023-01-01") & date <= as.Date("2023-09-01") ~ 1L,  # Ingolstadt
      MunicipalityCode == "11000000" & date >= as.Date("2023-02-01") ~ 1L,  # Berlin
      MunicipalityCode == "05113000" & date >= as.Date("2023-03-01") ~ 1L,  # Essen
      MunicipalityCode == "09362000" & date >= as.Date("2023-03-01") ~ 1L,  # Regensburg
      MunicipalityCode == "14612000" & date >= as.Date("2023-06-01") ~ 1L,  # Dresden
      MunicipalityCode == "05112000" & date >= as.Date("2023-10-01") ~ 1L,  # Duisburg
      MunicipalityCode == "09761000" & date >= as.Date("2023-10-01") & date <= as.Date("2025-12-01") ~ 1L,  # Augsburg
      MunicipalityCode == "05913000" & date >= as.Date("2023-11-01") ~ 1L,  # Dortmund
      MunicipalityCode == "06412000" & date >= as.Date("2023-11-01") & date <= as.Date("2025-05-01") ~ 1L,  # Frankfurt am Main
      MunicipalityCode == "06611000" & date >= as.Date("2024-10-01") ~ 1L,  # Kassel

      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  ) |>
  select(Municipality, MunicipalityCode, date, treatment) |>
  arrange(Municipality, MunicipalityCode, date) |>
  group_by(MunicipalityCode) |>
  mutate(ever_treated = max(treatment)) |>
  ungroup()
```

Dataset:

```{r}
# LOAD AND CLEAN THE RAW MaStR DUMP

data <- open_dataset(here("data", "raw", "EinheitenSolarJune_plugin.parquet"))

# Step 2.1: rename German → English
data <- data |>
  rename(
    UnitMastrNumber                          = EinheitMastrNummer,
    DateLastUpdate                           = DatumLetzteAktualisierung,
    LocationMastrNumber                      = LokationMaStRNummer,
    GridOperatorVerificationStatus           = NetzbetreiberpruefungStatus,
    GridOperatorVerificationDate             = NetzbetreiberpruefungDatum,
    PlantOperatorMastrNumber                 = AnlagenbetreiberMastrNummer,
    Country                                  = Land,
    FederalState                             = Bundesland,
    District                                 = Landkreis,
    Municipality                             = Gemeinde,
    MunicipalityCode                         = Gemeindeschluessel,
    PostalCode                               = Postleitzahl,
    City                                     = Ort,
    RegistrationDate                         = Registrierungsdatum,
    CommissioningDate                        = Inbetriebnahmedatum,
    UnitSystemStatus                         = EinheitSystemstatus,
    UnitOperationalStatus                    = EinheitBetriebsstatus,
    NotPresentInMigratedUnits                = NichtVorhandenInMigriertenEinheiten,
    PowerGenerationUnitName                  = NameStromerzeugungseinheit,
    Weic_NotAvailable                        = Weic_nv,
    PowerPlantNumber_NotAvailable            = Kraftwerksnummer_nv,
    EnergySource                             = Energietraeger,
    GrossCapacity                            = Bruttoleistung,
    NetNominalCapacity                       = Nettonennleistung,
    RemoteControllabilityGridOperator        = FernsteuerbarkeitNb,
    FeedInType                               = Einspeisungsart,
    AssignedActivePowerInverter              = ZugeordneteWirkleistungWechselrichter,
    NumberOfModules                          = AnzahlModule,
    TypeOfSolarSystem                        = ArtDerSolaranlage,
    PowerLimitation                          = Leistungsbegrenzung,
    UniformOrientationAndTiltAngle           = EinheitlicheAusrichtungUndNeigungswinkel,
    MainOrientation                          = Hauptausrichtung,
    MainOrientationTiltAngle                 = HauptausrichtungNeigungswinkel,
    UsageArea                                = Nutzungsbereich,
    EegMastrNumber                           = EegMaStRNummer,
    StorageAtSameLocation                    = SpeicherAmGleichenOrt,
    SecondaryOrientation                     = Nebenausrichtung,
    SecondaryOrientationTiltAngle            = NebenausrichtungNeigungswinkel,
    Street                                   = Strasse,
    StreetNotFound                           = StrasseNichtGefunden,
    HouseNumber_NotAvailable                 = Hausnummer_nv,
    HouseNumberNotFound                      = HausnummerNichtGefunden,
    Longitude                                = Laengengrad,
    Latitude                                 = Breitengrad,
    DateStartTemporaryDecommissioning        = DatumBeginnVoruebergehendeStilllegung,
    HouseNumber                              = Hausnummer,
    AddressAddition                          = Adresszusatz,
    RemoteControllabilityDirectMarketer      = FernsteuerbarkeitDv,
    PreviousPlantOperatorMastrNumber         = AltAnlagenbetreiberMastrNummer,
    DateOfOperatorChange                     = DatumDesBetreiberwechsels,
    DateRegistrationOfOperatorChange         = DatumRegistrierungDesBetreiberwechsels,
    CadastralDistrict                        = Gemarkung,
    FieldParcelNumbers                       = FlurFlurstuecknummern,
    ConnectionToExtraHighOrHighVoltage       = AnschlussAnHoechstOderHochSpannung,
    DatePermanentDecommissioning             = DatumEndgueltigeStilllegung,
    SizeOfUsedAreaInHectares                 = GroesseDerInAnspruchGenommenenFlaecheInHektar,
    PreviousUsageTypeOfArea                  = VorherigerNutzungsartenbereichDerFlaeche,
    PredominantUsageTypeBeforeSolarConstruction = UeberwiegendeNutzungsartDerFlaecheVorErrichtung,
    NameOfSolarPark                          = NameDesSolarparks,
    AdditionalFeaturesOfAreaAndCurrentUsage  = ZusaetzlicheMerkmaleDerFlaecheUndDerAktuellenFlaechennutzung,
    GenMastrNumber                           = GenMastrNummer,
    CommissioningDateAtCurrentLocation       = InbetriebnahmedatumAmAktuellenStandort,
    DispatchResponsible                      = Einsatzverantwortlicher,
    CitizenEnergy                            = Buergerenergie,
    DateResumptionOfOperation                = DatumWiederaufnahmeBetrieb,
    PlannedCommissioningDate                 = GeplantesInbetriebnahmedatum,
    ClearanceHeight                          = LichteHoehe,
    PowerPlantNumber                         = Kraftwerksnummer
  )

# Step 2.2: coerce numeric columns (XML parsing stores everything as character)
data <- data |>
  mutate(
    TypeOfSolarSystem           = as.integer(TypeOfSolarSystem),
    Country                     = as.integer(Country),
    FederalState                = as.integer(FederalState),
    GrossCapacity               = as.numeric(GrossCapacity),
    NetNominalCapacity          = as.numeric(NetNominalCapacity),
    AssignedActivePowerInverter = as.numeric(AssignedActivePowerInverter),
    NumberOfModules             = as.integer(NumberOfModules)
  )

# Step 2.3: lookup tables (TypeOfSolarSystem, Country, FederalState)
C1 <- data.frame(
  TypeOfSolarSystem.names = c(
    "Structural_facilities", "Other_Structural_facilities", "Open_space",
    "Bodies_water", "Large_parking_lot", "Plug_in_sola_system", "Onshore&Offshore_wind_power"
  ),
  TypeOfSolarSystem = as.integer(c(853, 2484, 852, 3002, 3058, 2961, NA))
)

C2 <- tibble(
  Country = as.integer(c(84, 231, 90, 66, 198, 206, 106)),
  Country.sn = c("Germany", "Switzerland", "Denmark", "Belgium", "Netherlands", "Austria", "France")
)

C3 <- data.frame(
  FederalState = as.integer(c(
    1409, 1402, 1400, 1403, 1412, 1408, 1410, 1407,
    1414, 1411, 1413, 1405, 1415, 1406, 1401, 1404
  )),
  FederalState.names = c(
    "North Rhine-Westphalia", "Baden-Württemberg", "Brandenburg", "Bavaria",
    "Saarland", "Lower Saxony", "Rhineland-Palatinate", "Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania",
    "Saxony-Anhalt", "Schleswig-Holstein", "Saxony", "Hesse",
    "Thuringia", "Hamburg", "Berlin", "Bremen"
  ),
  FederalStateCode = c(
    "DEA", "DE1", "DE4", "DE2",
    "DEC", "DE9", "DEB", "DEM",
    "DEE", "DEF", "DED", "DE7",
    "DEG", "DE6", "DE3", "DE5"
  )
)

# Step 2.4: attach lookup labels and codes to the dataset
data <- data |>
  left_join(C1, by = "TypeOfSolarSystem") |>
  relocate(TypeOfSolarSystem.names, .after = TypeOfSolarSystem) |>
  left_join(C2, by = "Country") |>
  relocate(Country.sn, .after = Country) |>
  left_join(C3, by = "FederalState") |>
  relocate(FederalState.names, .after = FederalState) |>
  relocate(FederalStateCode, .after = FederalState.names)

# Step 2.5: classify balcony PVs (Solarpaket-I reform on 2024-05-16 changed the threshold)
reform_date <- as.Date("2024-05-16")

data <- data |>
  mutate(
    RegistrationDate  = as.Date(RegistrationDate),
    CommissioningDate = as.Date(CommissioningDate),
    solar_category = case_when(
      TypeOfSolarSystem == 2961 & RegistrationDate <  reform_date & AssignedActivePowerInverter <= 0.6 ~ "Plug_in_sola_system - Balcony",
      TypeOfSolarSystem == 2961 & RegistrationDate >= reform_date & AssignedActivePowerInverter <= 0.8 & GrossCapacity <= 2.0 ~ "Plug_in_sola_system - Balcony",
      TypeOfSolarSystem == 2961 ~ "Plug_in_sola_system - Non-Balcony",
      TRUE ~ TypeOfSolarSystem.names
    )
  )
# Step 2.6: keep Germany only
data <- data |>
  filter(Country.sn == "Germany")

# Step 2.7: derive date variables at every frequency we may need downstream
data <- data |>
  mutate(
    date.registration.day     = RegistrationDate,
    date.registration.week    = floor_date(RegistrationDate,  "week"),
    date.registration.month   = floor_date(RegistrationDate,  "month"),
    date.registration.quarter = floor_date(RegistrationDate,  "quarter"),
    date.registration.year    = floor_date(RegistrationDate,  "year"),
    date.commission.day       = CommissioningDate,
    date.commission.week      = floor_date(CommissioningDate, "week"),
    date.commission.month     = floor_date(CommissioningDate, "month"),
    date.commission.quarter   = floor_date(CommissioningDate, "quarter"),
    date.commission.year      = floor_date(CommissioningDate, "year")
  )

# Step 2.8: pad MunicipalityCode to 8 digits (preserve leading zeros)
data <- data |>
  mutate(MunicipalityCode = str_pad(as.character(MunicipalityCode), 8, pad = "0"))

# FILTER TO BALCONY PVs IN TREATMENT MUNICIPALITIES, INSIDE THE PANEL RANGE

data <- data |>
  filter(solar_category == "Plug_in_sola_system - Balcony")

muni_all <- data.treatment |>
  distinct(Municipality, MunicipalityCode)

data <- data |>
  filter(MunicipalityCode %in% muni_all$MunicipalityCode)

lo <- min(all_dates)
hi <- max(all_dates)
data <- data |>
  filter(date.registration.month >= lo,
         date.registration.month <= hi)

# AGGREGATE TO MONTHLY OUTCOME PANEL (balanced, with cumulative stock)

data.outcome <- data |>
  count(MunicipalityCode, date = date.registration.month, name = "n_installations") |>
  collect() |>
  complete(
    MunicipalityCode = muni_all$MunicipalityCode,
    date             = all_dates,
    fill             = list(n_installations = 0L)
  ) |>
  left_join(muni_all, by = "MunicipalityCode") |>
  arrange(MunicipalityCode, date) |>
  group_by(MunicipalityCode) |>
  mutate(n_installations_cumulative = cumsum(n_installations)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(Municipality, MunicipalityCode, date,
         n_installations, n_installations_cumulative)

# POPULATION DENOMINATOR (2023, from Destatis regio)

pop_2023 <- read_parquet(here("data", "raw", "destatis_population_2023.parquet")) |>
  filter(`1_variable_code` == "GEMEIN",                # municipalities only
         is.na(`2_variable_attribute_code`),           # sex Total
         !is.na(`1_variable_attribute_label`),         # drop unnamed rows
         !value %in% c("-", ".")) |>                   # drop Destatis sentinels (- / .)
  transmute(
    Municipality     = `1_variable_attribute_label`,
    MunicipalityCode = `1_variable_attribute_code`,
    population_2023  = as.numeric(value)
  )

data.outcome <- data.outcome |>
  left_join(pop_2023 |> select(MunicipalityCode, population_2023),
            by = "MunicipalityCode") |>
  rename(population = population_2023) |>
  mutate(
    n_installations_per_1000            = n_installations            / population * 1000,
    n_installations_cumulative_per_1000 = n_installations_cumulative / population * 1000
  )

# COVARIATE: 2018 INCOME PER CAPITA (time-invariant)

# 2018 total income — Gesamtbetrag der Einkünfte (EKF002), in Tsd. EUR → EUR
income_2018 <- read_parquet(here("data", "raw", "destatis_income_2018.parquet")) |>
  filter(`1_variable_code` == "GEMEIN",                # municipalities only
         value_variable_code == "EKF002",              # total income (drops LSNW01/LSNW02)
         !is.na(`1_variable_attribute_label`),
         !value %in% c("-", ".")) |>
  transmute(
    Municipality     = `1_variable_attribute_label`,
    MunicipalityCode = `1_variable_attribute_code`,
    total_income_eur = as.numeric(value) * 1000        # Tsd. EUR -> EUR
  )

# 2018 population — denominator for per-capita income
pop_2018 <- read_parquet(here("data", "raw", "destatis_population_2018.parquet")) |>
  filter(`1_variable_code` == "GEMEIN",
         is.na(`2_variable_attribute_code`),
         !is.na(`1_variable_attribute_label`),
         !value %in% c("-", ".")) |>
  transmute(
    Municipality     = `1_variable_attribute_label`,
    MunicipalityCode = `1_variable_attribute_code`,
    population_2018  = as.numeric(value)
  )

income_pc_2018 <- income_2018 |>
  inner_join(pop_2018 |> select(MunicipalityCode, population_2018),
             by = "MunicipalityCode") |>
  mutate(income_per_capita_eur = total_income_eur / population_2018) |>
  select(Municipality, MunicipalityCode, income_per_capita_eur)

# MERGE — outcome (panel) + treatment (panel) + income covariate (invariant)

data.merged <- data.outcome |>
  left_join(data.treatment |> select(MunicipalityCode, date, treatment, ever_treated),
            by = c("MunicipalityCode", "date")) |>
  left_join(income_pc_2018 |> select(MunicipalityCode, income_per_capita_eur),
            by = "MunicipalityCode") |>
  mutate(year = year(date)) |>
  arrange(MunicipalityCode, date)

data.merged |> print() |> glimpse()

# CONVERT — cast all numeric columns to <dbl>; add integer ID / time index
data.merged <- data.merged |>
  mutate(
    across(!c(Municipality, MunicipalityCode, date), as.double),
    id   = as.double(factor(MunicipalityCode)),
    time = as.double(factor(date))
  )

```

Save it:

```{r}
write_parquet(
  data.merged,
  here("data", "data_monthly.parquet")
)

data.monthly <- read_parquet(
  here("data", "data_monthly.parquet")
)

data.monthly |> print() |> glimpse()
```

# 2. Quarterly panel

Treatment dataset (quarterly):

```{r}
# TREATMENT PANEL — QUARTERLY balanced panel of (muni, date) with treatment

all_dates.quarterly <- seq.Date(
  floor_date(as.Date("2019-02-01"), "quarter"),
  floor_date(as.Date("2026-05-07"), "quarter"),
  by = "quarter"
)

muni_all <- tribble(
  ~Municipality,                    ~MunicipalityCode,

  "Freiburg im Breisgau, Stadt",    "08311000",
  "Oldenburg (Oldenburg), Stadt",   "03403000",
  "Dusseldorf, Stadt",              "05111000",

  "Dortmund",                       "05913000",

  "Lüneburg, Hansestadt",           "03355022",

data.treatment.quarterly <- crossing(
  MunicipalityCode = muni_all$MunicipalityCode,
  date = all_dates.quarterly
) |>
  left_join(muni_all, by = "MunicipalityCode") |>
  mutate(
    treatment = case_when(
      MunicipalityCode == "08311000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2019-09-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Freiburg im Breisgau
      MunicipalityCode == "03403000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2020-01-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2023-03-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Oldenburg
      MunicipalityCode == "05111000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2020-05-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2026-01-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Dusseldorf
      MunicipalityCode == "08111000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2020-11-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2025-12-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Stuttgart
      MunicipalityCode == "05711000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2020-11-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2023-12-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Bielefeld
      MunicipalityCode == "06411000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2021-07-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Darmstadt
      MunicipalityCode == "05314000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2021-09-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Bonn
      MunicipalityCode == "03159016" & (  # Göttingen
        (date >= floor_date(as.Date("2021-11-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2025-12-01"), "quarter")) |
        (date >= floor_date(as.Date("2026-06-01"), "quarter"))
      ) ~ 1L,
      MunicipalityCode == "12054000" & (  # Potsdam
        (date >= floor_date(as.Date("2022-03-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2022-12-01"), "quarter")) |
        (date >= floor_date(as.Date("2023-07-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2023-12-01"), "quarter")) |
        (date >= floor_date(as.Date("2024-03-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2024-08-01"), "quarter")) |

      ) ~ 1L,
      MunicipalityCode == "05978012" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2022-03-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2023-12-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Fröndenberg
      MunicipalityCode == "09190157" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2022-04-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2024-12-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Weilheim
      MunicipalityCode == "05315000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2022-04-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Koln
      MunicipalityCode == "03101000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2022-04-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Braunschweig
      MunicipalityCode == "01002000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2022-04-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2025-12-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Kiel
      MunicipalityCode == "08221000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2022-09-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2024-03-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Heidelberg
      MunicipalityCode == "09162000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2022-10-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Munchen
      MunicipalityCode == "16053000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2022-11-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2023-12-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Jena
      MunicipalityCode == "03455007" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2023-01-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2023-12-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Jever
      MunicipalityCode == "08421000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2023-01-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2026-08-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Ulm
      MunicipalityCode == "09161000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2023-01-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2023-09-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Ingolstadt
      MunicipalityCode == "11000000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2023-02-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Berlin
      MunicipalityCode == "05113000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2023-03-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Essen
      MunicipalityCode == "09362000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2023-03-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Regensburg
      MunicipalityCode == "14612000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2023-06-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Dresden
      MunicipalityCode == "05112000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2023-10-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Duisburg
      MunicipalityCode == "09761000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2023-10-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2025-12-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Augsburg
      MunicipalityCode == "05913000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2023-11-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Dortmund
      MunicipalityCode == "06412000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2023-11-01"), "quarter") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2025-05-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Frankfurt am Main
      MunicipalityCode == "06611000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2024-10-01"), "quarter") ~ 1L,  # Kassel

      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  ) |>
  select(Municipality, MunicipalityCode, date, treatment) |>
  arrange(Municipality, MunicipalityCode, date) |>
  group_by(MunicipalityCode) |>
  mutate(ever_treated = max(treatment)) |>
  ungroup()
```

Dataset:

```{r}
# LOAD AND CLEAN THE RAW MaStR DUMP

data.quarterly <- open_dataset(here("data", "raw", "EinheitenSolarJune_plugin.parquet"))

# Step 2.1: rename German → English
data.quarterly <- data.quarterly |>
  rename(
    UnitMastrNumber                          = EinheitMastrNummer,
    DateLastUpdate                           = DatumLetzteAktualisierung,
    LocationMastrNumber                      = LokationMaStRNummer,
    GridOperatorVerificationStatus           = NetzbetreiberpruefungStatus,
    GridOperatorVerificationDate             = NetzbetreiberpruefungDatum,
    PlantOperatorMastrNumber                 = AnlagenbetreiberMastrNummer,
    Country                                  = Land,
    FederalState                             = Bundesland,
    District                                 = Landkreis,
    Municipality                             = Gemeinde,
    MunicipalityCode                         = Gemeindeschluessel,
    PostalCode                               = Postleitzahl,
    City                                     = Ort,
    RegistrationDate                         = Registrierungsdatum,
    CommissioningDate                        = Inbetriebnahmedatum,
    UnitSystemStatus                         = EinheitSystemstatus,
    UnitOperationalStatus                    = EinheitBetriebsstatus,
    NotPresentInMigratedUnits                = NichtVorhandenInMigriertenEinheiten,
    PowerGenerationUnitName                  = NameStromerzeugungseinheit,
    Weic_NotAvailable                        = Weic_nv,
    PowerPlantNumber_NotAvailable            = Kraftwerksnummer_nv,
    EnergySource                             = Energietraeger,
    GrossCapacity                            = Bruttoleistung,
    NetNominalCapacity                       = Nettonennleistung,
    RemoteControllabilityGridOperator        = FernsteuerbarkeitNb,
    FeedInType                               = Einspeisungsart,
    AssignedActivePowerInverter              = ZugeordneteWirkleistungWechselrichter,
    NumberOfModules                          = AnzahlModule,
    TypeOfSolarSystem                        = ArtDerSolaranlage,
    PowerLimitation                          = Leistungsbegrenzung,
    UniformOrientationAndTiltAngle           = EinheitlicheAusrichtungUndNeigungswinkel,
    MainOrientation                          = Hauptausrichtung,
    MainOrientationTiltAngle                 = HauptausrichtungNeigungswinkel,
    UsageArea                                = Nutzungsbereich,
    EegMastrNumber                           = EegMaStRNummer,
    StorageAtSameLocation                    = SpeicherAmGleichenOrt,
    SecondaryOrientation                     = Nebenausrichtung,
    SecondaryOrientationTiltAngle            = NebenausrichtungNeigungswinkel,
    Street                                   = Strasse,
    StreetNotFound                           = StrasseNichtGefunden,
    HouseNumber_NotAvailable                 = Hausnummer_nv,
    HouseNumberNotFound                      = HausnummerNichtGefunden,
    Longitude                                = Laengengrad,
    Latitude                                 = Breitengrad,
    DateStartTemporaryDecommissioning        = DatumBeginnVoruebergehendeStilllegung,
    HouseNumber                              = Hausnummer,
    AddressAddition                          = Adresszusatz,
    RemoteControllabilityDirectMarketer      = FernsteuerbarkeitDv,
    PreviousPlantOperatorMastrNumber         = AltAnlagenbetreiberMastrNummer,
    DateOfOperatorChange                     = DatumDesBetreiberwechsels,
    DateRegistrationOfOperatorChange         = DatumRegistrierungDesBetreiberwechsels,
    CadastralDistrict                        = Gemarkung,
    FieldParcelNumbers                       = FlurFlurstuecknummern,
    ConnectionToExtraHighOrHighVoltage       = AnschlussAnHoechstOderHochSpannung,
    DatePermanentDecommissioning             = DatumEndgueltigeStilllegung,
    SizeOfUsedAreaInHectares                 = GroesseDerInAnspruchGenommenenFlaecheInHektar,
    PreviousUsageTypeOfArea                  = VorherigerNutzungsartenbereichDerFlaeche,
    PredominantUsageTypeBeforeSolarConstruction = UeberwiegendeNutzungsartDerFlaecheVorErrichtung,
    NameOfSolarPark                          = NameDesSolarparks,
    AdditionalFeaturesOfAreaAndCurrentUsage  = ZusaetzlicheMerkmaleDerFlaecheUndDerAktuellenFlaechennutzung,
    GenMastrNumber                           = GenMastrNummer,
    CommissioningDateAtCurrentLocation       = InbetriebnahmedatumAmAktuellenStandort,
    DispatchResponsible                      = Einsatzverantwortlicher,
    CitizenEnergy                            = Buergerenergie,
    DateResumptionOfOperation                = DatumWiederaufnahmeBetrieb,
    PlannedCommissioningDate                 = GeplantesInbetriebnahmedatum,
    ClearanceHeight                          = LichteHoehe,
    PowerPlantNumber                         = Kraftwerksnummer
  )

# Step 2.2: coerce numeric columns (XML parsing stores everything as character)
data.quarterly <- data.quarterly |>
  mutate(
    TypeOfSolarSystem           = as.integer(TypeOfSolarSystem),
    Country                     = as.integer(Country),
    FederalState                = as.integer(FederalState),
    GrossCapacity               = as.numeric(GrossCapacity),
    NetNominalCapacity          = as.numeric(NetNominalCapacity),
    AssignedActivePowerInverter = as.numeric(AssignedActivePowerInverter),
    NumberOfModules             = as.integer(NumberOfModules)
  )

# Step 2.3: lookup tables (TypeOfSolarSystem, Country, FederalState)
C1.quarterly <- data.frame(
  TypeOfSolarSystem.names = c(
    "Structural_facilities", "Other_Structural_facilities", "Open_space",
    "Bodies_water", "Large_parking_lot", "Plug_in_sola_system", "Onshore&Offshore_wind_power"
  ),
  TypeOfSolarSystem = as.integer(c(853, 2484, 852, 3002, 3058, 2961, NA))
)

C2.quarterly <- tibble(
  Country = as.integer(c(84, 231, 90, 66, 198, 206, 106)),
  Country.sn = c("Germany", "Switzerland", "Denmark", "Belgium", "Netherlands", "Austria", "France")
)

C3.quarterly <- data.frame(
  FederalState = as.integer(c(
    1409, 1402, 1400, 1403, 1412, 1408, 1410, 1407,
    1414, 1411, 1413, 1405, 1415, 1406, 1401, 1404
  )),
  FederalState.names = c(
    "North Rhine-Westphalia", "Baden-Württemberg", "Brandenburg", "Bavaria",
    "Saarland", "Lower Saxony", "Rhineland-Palatinate", "Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania",
    "Saxony-Anhalt", "Schleswig-Holstein", "Saxony", "Hesse",
    "Thuringia", "Hamburg", "Berlin", "Bremen"
  ),
  FederalStateCode = c(
    "DEA", "DE1", "DE4", "DE2",
    "DEC", "DE9", "DEB", "DEM",
    "DEE", "DEF", "DED", "DE7",
    "DEG", "DE6", "DE3", "DE5"
  )
)

# Step 2.4: attach lookup labels and codes to the dataset
data.quarterly <- data.quarterly |>
  left_join(C1.quarterly, by = "TypeOfSolarSystem") |>
  relocate(TypeOfSolarSystem.names, .after = TypeOfSolarSystem) |>
  left_join(C2.quarterly, by = "Country") |>
  relocate(Country.sn, .after = Country) |>
  left_join(C3.quarterly, by = "FederalState") |>
  relocate(FederalState.names, .after = FederalState) |>
  relocate(FederalStateCode, .after = FederalState.names)

# Step 2.5: classify balcony PVs (Solarpaket-I reform on 2024-05-16 changed the threshold)
reform_date <- as.Date("2024-05-16")

data.quarterly <- data.quarterly |>
  mutate(
    RegistrationDate  = as.Date(RegistrationDate),
    CommissioningDate = as.Date(CommissioningDate),
    solar_category = case_when(
      TypeOfSolarSystem == 2961 & RegistrationDate <  reform_date & AssignedActivePowerInverter <= 0.6 ~ "Plug_in_sola_system - Balcony",
      TypeOfSolarSystem == 2961 & RegistrationDate >= reform_date & AssignedActivePowerInverter <= 0.8 & GrossCapacity <= 2.0 ~ "Plug_in_sola_system - Balcony",
      TypeOfSolarSystem == 2961 ~ "Plug_in_sola_system - Non-Balcony",
      TRUE ~ TypeOfSolarSystem.names
    )
  )
# Step 2.6: keep Germany only
data.quarterly <- data.quarterly |>
  filter(Country.sn == "Germany")

# Step 2.7: derive date variables at every frequency we may need downstream
data.quarterly <- data.quarterly |>
  mutate(
    date.registration.day     = RegistrationDate,
    date.registration.week    = floor_date(RegistrationDate,  "week"),
    date.registration.month   = floor_date(RegistrationDate,  "month"),
    date.registration.quarter = floor_date(RegistrationDate,  "quarter"),
    date.registration.year    = floor_date(RegistrationDate,  "year"),
    date.commission.day       = CommissioningDate,
    date.commission.week      = floor_date(CommissioningDate, "week"),
    date.commission.month     = floor_date(CommissioningDate, "month"),
    date.commission.quarter   = floor_date(CommissioningDate, "quarter"),
    date.commission.year      = floor_date(CommissioningDate, "year")
  )

# Step 2.8: pad MunicipalityCode to 8 digits (preserve leading zeros)
data.quarterly <- data.quarterly |>
  mutate(MunicipalityCode = str_pad(as.character(MunicipalityCode), 8, pad = "0"))

# FILTER TO BALCONY PVs IN TREATMENT MUNICIPALITIES, INSIDE THE PANEL RANGE

data.quarterly <- data.quarterly |>
  filter(solar_category == "Plug_in_sola_system - Balcony")

muni_all.quarterly <- data.treatment.quarterly |>
  distinct(Municipality, MunicipalityCode)

data.quarterly <- data.quarterly |>
  filter(MunicipalityCode %in% muni_all.quarterly$MunicipalityCode)

lo.quarterly <- min(all_dates.quarterly)
hi.quarterly <- max(all_dates.quarterly)
data.quarterly <- data.quarterly |>
  filter(date.registration.quarter >= lo.quarterly,
         date.registration.quarter <= hi.quarterly)

# AGGREGATE TO QUARTERLY OUTCOME PANEL (balanced, with cumulative stock)

data.outcome.quarterly <- data.quarterly |>
  count(MunicipalityCode, date = date.registration.quarter, name = "n_installations") |>
  collect() |>
  complete(
    MunicipalityCode = muni_all.quarterly$MunicipalityCode,
    date             = all_dates.quarterly,
    fill             = list(n_installations = 0L)
  ) |>
  left_join(muni_all.quarterly, by = "MunicipalityCode") |>
  arrange(MunicipalityCode, date) |>
  group_by(MunicipalityCode) |>
  mutate(n_installations_cumulative = cumsum(n_installations)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(Municipality, MunicipalityCode, date,
         n_installations, n_installations_cumulative)

# POPULATION DENOMINATOR (2023, from Destatis regio)

pop_2023.quarterly <- read_parquet(here("data", "raw", "destatis_population_2023.parquet")) |>
  filter(`1_variable_code` == "GEMEIN",                # municipalities only
         is.na(`2_variable_attribute_code`),           # sex Total
         !is.na(`1_variable_attribute_label`),         # drop unnamed rows
         !value %in% c("-", ".")) |>                   # drop Destatis sentinels (- / .)
  transmute(
    Municipality     = `1_variable_attribute_label`,
    MunicipalityCode = `1_variable_attribute_code`,
    population_2023  = as.numeric(value)
  )

data.outcome.quarterly <- data.outcome.quarterly |>
  left_join(pop_2023.quarterly |> select(MunicipalityCode, population_2023),
            by = "MunicipalityCode") |>
  rename(population = population_2023) |>
  mutate(
    n_installations_per_1000            = n_installations            / population * 1000,
    n_installations_cumulative_per_1000 = n_installations_cumulative / population * 1000
  )

# COVARIATE: 2018 INCOME PER CAPITA (time-invariant)

# 2018 total income — Gesamtbetrag der Einkünfte (EKF002), in Tsd. EUR → EUR
income_2018.quarterly <- read_parquet(here("data", "raw", "destatis_income_2018.parquet")) |>
  filter(`1_variable_code` == "GEMEIN",                # municipalities only
         value_variable_code == "EKF002",              # total income (drops LSNW01/LSNW02)
         !is.na(`1_variable_attribute_label`),
         !value %in% c("-", ".")) |>
  transmute(
    Municipality     = `1_variable_attribute_label`,
    MunicipalityCode = `1_variable_attribute_code`,
    total_income_eur = as.numeric(value) * 1000        # Tsd. EUR -> EUR
  )

# 2018 population — denominator for per-capita income
pop_2018.quarterly <- read_parquet(here("data", "raw", "destatis_population_2018.parquet")) |>
  filter(`1_variable_code` == "GEMEIN",
         is.na(`2_variable_attribute_code`),
         !is.na(`1_variable_attribute_label`),
         !value %in% c("-", ".")) |>
  transmute(
    Municipality     = `1_variable_attribute_label`,
    MunicipalityCode = `1_variable_attribute_code`,
    population_2018  = as.numeric(value)
  )

income_pc_2018.quarterly <- income_2018.quarterly |>
  inner_join(pop_2018.quarterly |> select(MunicipalityCode, population_2018),
             by = "MunicipalityCode") |>
  mutate(income_per_capita_eur = total_income_eur / population_2018) |>
  select(Municipality, MunicipalityCode, income_per_capita_eur)

# MERGE — outcome (panel) + treatment (panel) + income covariate (invariant)

data.merged.quarterly <- data.outcome.quarterly |>
  left_join(data.treatment.quarterly |> select(MunicipalityCode, date, treatment, ever_treated),
            by = c("MunicipalityCode", "date")) |>
  left_join(income_pc_2018.quarterly |> select(MunicipalityCode, income_per_capita_eur),
            by = "MunicipalityCode") |>
  mutate(year = year(date)) |>
  arrange(MunicipalityCode, date)

data.merged.quarterly |> print() |> glimpse()

# CONVERT — cast all numeric columns to <dbl>; add integer ID / time index
data.merged.quarterly <- data.merged.quarterly |>
  mutate(
    across(!c(Municipality, MunicipalityCode, date), as.double),
    id   = as.double(factor(MunicipalityCode)),
    time = as.double(factor(date))
  )
```

Treatment dataset (yearly):

```{r}
# TREATMENT PANEL — YEARLY balanced panel of (muni, date) with treatment

all_dates.yearly <- seq.Date(
  floor_date(as.Date("2019-02-01"), "year"),
  floor_date(as.Date("2026-05-07"), "year"),
  by = "year"
)

data.treatment.yearly <- crossing(
  MunicipalityCode = muni_all$MunicipalityCode,
  date = all_dates.yearly
) |>
  left_join(muni_all, by = "MunicipalityCode") |>
  mutate(
    treatment = case_when(
      MunicipalityCode == "08311000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2019-09-01"), "year") ~ 1L,  # Freiburg im Breisgau
      MunicipalityCode == "03403000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2020-01-01"), "year") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2023-03-01"), "year") ~ 1L,  # Oldenburg

      MunicipalityCode == "09761000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2023-10-01"), "year") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2025-12-01"), "year") ~ 1L,  # Augsburg
      MunicipalityCode == "05913000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2023-11-01"), "year") ~ 1L,  # Dortmund
      MunicipalityCode == "06412000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2023-11-01"), "year") & date <= floor_date(as.Date("2025-05-01"), "year") ~ 1L,  # Frankfurt am Main
      MunicipalityCode == "06611000" & date >= floor_date(as.Date("2024-10-01"), "year") ~ 1L,  # Kassel

      TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  ) |>
  select(Municipality, MunicipalityCode, date, treatment) |>
  arrange(Municipality, MunicipalityCode, date) |>
  group_by(MunicipalityCode) |>
  mutate(ever_treated = max(treatment)) |>
  ungroup()
```

Dataset:

```{r}
# LOAD AND CLEAN THE RAW MaStR DUMP

data.yearly <- open_dataset(here("data", "raw", "EinheitenSolarJune_plugin.parquet"))

# Step 2.1: rename German → English
data.yearly <- data.yearly |>
  rename(

    PreviousPlantOperatorMastrNumber         = AltAnlagenbetreiberMastrNummer,
    DateOfOperatorChange                     = DatumDesBetreiberwechsels,
    DateRegistrationOfOperatorChange         = DatumRegistrierungDesBetreiberwechsels,
    CadastralDistrict                        = Gemarkung,
    FieldParcelNumbers                       = FlurFlurstuecknummern,
    ConnectionToExtraHighOrHighVoltage       = AnschlussAnHoechstOderHochSpannung,
    DatePermanentDecommissioning             = DatumEndgueltigeStilllegung,
    SizeOfUsedAreaInHectares                 = GroesseDerInAnspruchGenommenenFlaecheInHektar,
    PreviousUsageTypeOfArea                  = VorherigerNutzungsartenbereichDerFlaeche,
    PredominantUsageTypeBeforeSolarConstruction = UeberwiegendeNutzungsartDerFlaecheVorErrichtung,
    NameOfSolarPark                          = NameDesSolarparks,
    AdditionalFeaturesOfAreaAndCurrentUsage  = ZusaetzlicheMerkmaleDerFlaecheUndDerAktuellenFlaechennutzung,
    GenMastrNumber                           = GenMastrNummer,
    CommissioningDateAtCurrentLocation       = InbetriebnahmedatumAmAktuellenStandort,
    DispatchResponsible                      = Einsatzverantwortlicher,
    CitizenEnergy                            = Buergerenergie,
    DateResumptionOfOperation                = DatumWiederaufnahmeBetrieb,

    ClearanceHeight                          = LichteHoehe,
    PowerPlantNumber                         = Kraftwerksnummer
  )

# Step 2.2: coerce numeric columns (XML parsing stores everything as character)
data.yearly <- data.yearly |>
  mutate(
    TypeOfSolarSystem           = as.integer(TypeOfSolarSystem),
    Country                     = as.integer(Country),
    FederalState                = as.integer(FederalState),
    GrossCapacity               = as.numeric(GrossCapacity),
    NetNominalCapacity          = as.numeric(NetNominalCapacity),
    AssignedActivePowerInverter = as.numeric(AssignedActivePowerInverter),
    NumberOfModules             = as.integer(NumberOfModules)
  )

# Step 2.3: lookup tables (TypeOfSolarSystem, Country, FederalState)
C1.yearly <- data.frame(
  TypeOfSolarSystem.names = c(
    "Structural_facilities", "Other_Structural_facilities", "Open_space",
    "Bodies_water", "Large_parking_lot", "Plug_in_sola_system", "Onshore&Offshore_wind_power"
  ),
  TypeOfSolarSystem = as.integer(c(853, 2484, 852, 3002, 3058, 2961, NA))
)

C2.yearly <- tibble(
  Country = as.integer(c(84, 231, 90, 66, 198, 206, 106)),
  Country.sn = c("Germany", "Switzerland", "Denmark", "Belgium", "Netherlands", "Austria", "France")
)

C3.yearly <- data.frame(
  FederalState = as.integer(c(
    1409, 1402, 1400, 1403, 1412, 1408, 1410, 1407,
    1414, 1411, 1413, 1405, 1415, 1406, 1401, 1404
  )),
  FederalState.names = c(
    "North Rhine-Westphalia", "Baden-Württemberg", "Brandenburg", "Bavaria",
    "Saarland", "Lower Saxony", "Rhineland-Palatinate", "Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania",
    "Saxony-Anhalt", "Schleswig-Holstein", "Saxony", "Hesse",
    "Thuringia", "Hamburg", "Berlin", "Bremen"
  ),
  FederalStateCode = c(
    "DEA", "DE1", "DE4", "DE2",
    "DEC", "DE9", "DEB", "DEM",
    "DEE", "DEF", "DED", "DE7",
    "DEG", "DE6", "DE3", "DE5"
  )
)

# Step 2.4: attach lookup labels and codes to the dataset
data.yearly <- data.yearly |>
  left_join(C1.yearly, by = "TypeOfSolarSystem") |>
  relocate(TypeOfSolarSystem.names, .after = TypeOfSolarSystem) |>
  left_join(C2.yearly, by = "Country") |>
  relocate(Country.sn, .after = Country) |>
  left_join(C3.yearly, by = "FederalState") |>
  relocate(FederalState.names, .after = FederalState) |>
  relocate(FederalStateCode, .after = FederalState.names)

# Step 2.5: classify balcony PVs (Solarpaket-I reform on 2024-05-16 changed the threshold)
reform_date <- as.Date("2024-05-16")

data.yearly <- data.yearly |>
  mutate(
    RegistrationDate  = as.Date(RegistrationDate),
    CommissioningDate = as.Date(CommissioningDate),
    solar_category = case_when(
      TypeOfSolarSystem == 2961 & RegistrationDate <  reform_date & AssignedActivePowerInverter <= 0.6 ~ "Plug_in_sola_system - Balcony",
      TypeOfSolarSystem == 2961 & RegistrationDate >= reform_date & AssignedActivePowerInverter <= 0.8 & GrossCapacity <= 2.0 ~ "Plug_in_sola_system - Balcony",
      TypeOfSolarSystem == 2961 ~ "Plug_in_sola_system - Non-Balcony",
      TRUE ~ TypeOfSolarSystem.names
    )
  )
# Step 2.6: keep Germany only
data.yearly <- data.yearly |>
  filter(Country.sn == "Germany")

# Step 2.7: derive date variables at every frequency we may need downstream
data.yearly <- data.yearly |>
  mutate(
    date.registration.day     = RegistrationDate,
    date.registration.week    = floor_date(RegistrationDate,  "week"),
    date.registration.month   = floor_date(RegistrationDate,  "month"),
    date.registration.quarter = floor_date(RegistrationDate,  "quarter"),
    date.registration.year    = floor_date(RegistrationDate,  "year"),
    date.commission.day       = CommissioningDate,
    date.commission.week      = floor_date(CommissioningDate, "week"),
    date.commission.month     = floor_date(CommissioningDate, "month"),
    date.commission.quarter   = floor_date(CommissioningDate, "quarter"),
    date.commission.year      = floor_date(CommissioningDate, "year")
  )

# Step 2.8: pad MunicipalityCode to 8 digits (preserve leading zeros)
data.yearly <- data.yearly |>
  mutate(MunicipalityCode = str_pad(as.character(MunicipalityCode), 8, pad = "0"))

# FILTER TO BALCONY PVs IN TREATMENT MUNICIPALITIES, INSIDE THE PANEL RANGE

data.yearly <- data.yearly |>
  filter(solar_category == "Plug_in_sola_system - Balcony")

muni_all.yearly <- data.treatment.yearly |>
  distinct(Municipality, MunicipalityCode)

data.yearly <- data.yearly |>
  filter(MunicipalityCode %in% muni_all.yearly$MunicipalityCode)

lo.yearly <- min(all_dates.yearly)
hi.yearly <- max(all_dates.yearly)
data.yearly <- data.yearly |>
  filter(date.registration.year >= lo.yearly,
         date.registration.year <= hi.yearly)

# AGGREGATE TO YEARLY OUTCOME PANEL (balanced, with cumulative stock)

data.outcome.yearly <- data.yearly |>
  count(MunicipalityCode, date = date.registration.year, name = "n_installations") |>
  collect() |>
  complete(
    MunicipalityCode = muni_all.yearly$MunicipalityCode,
    date             = all_dates.yearly,
    fill             = list(n_installations = 0L)
  ) |>
  left_join(muni_all.yearly, by = "MunicipalityCode") |>
  arrange(MunicipalityCode, date) |>
  group_by(MunicipalityCode) |>
  mutate(n_installations_cumulative = cumsum(n_installations)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(Municipality, MunicipalityCode, date,
         n_installations, n_installations_cumulative)

# POPULATION DENOMINATOR (2023, from Destatis regio)

pop_2023.yearly <- read_parquet(here("data", "raw", "destatis_population_2023.parquet")) |>
  filter(`1_variable_code` == "GEMEIN",                # municipalities only
         is.na(`2_variable_attribute_code`),           # sex Total
         !is.na(`1_variable_attribute_label`),         # drop unnamed rows
         !value %in% c("-", ".")) |>                   # drop Destatis sentinels (- / .)
  transmute(
    Municipality     = `1_variable_attribute_label`,
    MunicipalityCode = `1_variable_attribute_code`,
    population_2023  = as.numeric(value)
  )

data.outcome.yearly <- data.outcome.yearly |>
  left_join(pop_2023.yearly |> select(MunicipalityCode, population_2023),
            by = "MunicipalityCode") |>
  rename(population = population_2023) |>
  mutate(
    n_installations_per_1000            = n_installations            / population * 1000,
    n_installations_cumulative_per_1000 = n_installations_cumulative / population * 1000
  )

# COVARIATE: 2018 INCOME PER CAPITA (time-invariant)

# 2018 total income — Gesamtbetrag der Einkünfte (EKF002), in Tsd. EUR → EUR
income_2018.yearly <- read_parquet(here("data", "raw", "destatis_income_2018.parquet")) |>
  filter(`1_variable_code` == "GEMEIN",                # municipalities only
         value_variable_code == "EKF002",              # total income (drops LSNW01/LSNW02)
         !is.na(`1_variable_attribute_label`),
         !value %in% c("-", ".")) |>
  transmute(
    Municipality     = `1_variable_attribute_label`,
    MunicipalityCode = `1_variable_attribute_code`,
    total_income_eur = as.numeric(value) * 1000        # Tsd. EUR -> EUR
  )

# 2018 population — denominator for per-capita income
pop_2018.yearly <- read_parquet(here("data", "raw", "destatis_population_2018.parquet")) |>
  filter(`1_variable_code` == "GEMEIN",
         is.na(`2_variable_attribute_code`),
         !is.na(`1_variable_attribute_label`),
         !value %in% c("-", ".")) |>
  transmute(
    Municipality     = `1_variable_attribute_label`,
    MunicipalityCode = `1_variable_attribute_code`,
    population_2018  = as.numeric(value)
  )

income_pc_2018.yearly <- income_2018.yearly |>
  inner_join(pop_2018.yearly |> select(MunicipalityCode, population_2018),
             by = "MunicipalityCode") |>
  mutate(income_per_capita_eur = total_income_eur / population_2018) |>
  select(Municipality, MunicipalityCode, income_per_capita_eur)

# MERGE — outcome (panel) + treatment (panel) + income covariate (invariant)

data.merged.yearly <- data.outcome.yearly |>
  left_join(data.treatment.yearly |> select(MunicipalityCode, date, treatment, ever_treated),
            by = c("MunicipalityCode", "date")) |>
  left_join(income_pc_2018.yearly |> select(MunicipalityCode, income_per_capita_eur),
            by = "MunicipalityCode") |>
  mutate(year = year(date)) |>
  arrange(MunicipalityCode, date)

data.merged.yearly |> print() |> glimpse()

# CONVERT — cast all numeric columns to <dbl>; add integer ID / time index
data.merged.yearly <- data.merged.yearly |>
  mutate(
    across(!c(Municipality, MunicipalityCode, date), as.double),
    id   = as.double(factor(MunicipalityCode)),
    time = as.double(factor(date))
  )
```

# 4. Verification — the three panels must agree

> Guards against the three `case_when` blocks drifting apart. If a municipality is added to
> one chapter but not the others, this chunk fails loudly instead of silently coding it as a
> never-treated control.

```{r}
ev <- function(d) d |> distinct(MunicipalityCode, ever_treated) |> arrange(MunicipalityCode)

stopifnot(
  "monthly and quarterly disagree on ever_treated" = identical(ev(data.merged), ev(data.merged.quarterly)),
  "monthly and yearly disagree on ever_treated"    = identical(ev(data.merged), ev(data.merged.yearly))
)

stopifnot(
  "monthly panel not balanced"   = nrow(data.merged)           == n_distinct(data.merged$MunicipalityCode)           * length(all_dates),
  "quarterly panel not balanced" = nrow(data.merged.quarterly) == n_distinct(data.merged.quarterly$MunicipalityCode) * length(all_dates.quarterly),
  "yearly panel not balanced"    = nrow(data.merged.yearly)    == n_distinct(data.merged.yearly$MunicipalityCode)    * length(all_dates.yearly)
)

cat("OK — the three panels agree.\n")
cat("municipalities:", nrow(ev(data.merged)), "\n")
cat("ever-treated  :", sum(ev(data.merged)$ever_treated), "\n")
cat("months        :", length(all_dates), "\n")
cat("quarters      :", length(all_dates.quarterly), "\n")
cat("years         :", length(all_dates.yearly), "\n")
```
